# short-link lane (engine/marketing/links.py, D07 W1a): orphaned atomic-write
# temps possible only after a hard crash mid-write; pages themselves ARE committed.
site/go/**/.tmp_*
# no trailing slash: a trailing-slash pattern matches DIRECTORIES ONLY, so a
# SYMLINK at this path is not ignored — which is how a machine-local absolute-path
# symlink reached a commit (a crop harness links the nightly artifacts in from the
# main checkout, an aborted run left it behind, and a broad `git add` swept it up).
site/stockdata
site/ohlc/
site/stockbrief/
site/chinastockdata/
site/chinamechanicsdata/
site/hkstockdata/
site/canadastockdata/
site/intlstockdata/
site/chinaohlc/
site/canadaohlc/
site/intlohlc/
site/hkohlc/
site/intraday/
# machine-consumable contract plane (scripts/build_feeds.py) — R2-only by design,
# regenerated every daily run; consumers read the R2 _manifest.json, never git
site/feeds/
# live intraday overlay — runtime artifact written by scripts/build_live_overlay (intraday
# cron) and by the offline test path; never committed (the cron force-pushes / re-emits it).
site/live/
